column1: # Looks the mod gives some places only (client/AreaLooks), written by tools/arealooks.py: which look, on which blocks,
# over which part of the map (x0 z0 to x1 z1; y0 y1 the heights, - for every height), the textures swapped.
# swap: textures for others (old=new, the new ones the mod's own, in textures/block/area; @4: laid from where the face
# is, a picture four blocks across). roof, roof_green, roof_gym: rows of tiles along the eaves (HeartGold's red, the
# green houses' green, the Gyms' tan). sign: shelves and standing pale oak
# signs as HeartGold's signs. wood_sign: standing spruce signs as its wooden sign, taller. wood_board: shelves as
# the sign in wood (our wooden sign). roof_museum: the Museum's purple tiles. grass_edge: the grass's tufts
# onto the dripstone round the water. kerb: a grey kerb with the grass rounded onto it, on a path's blocks.
# rooms: interiors for a look in the interiors (the forest), not John's world.
